title: SensorDash · Reporting summary
description: Daily, weekly and monthly telemetry summaries. Choose Last 24 hours, Last 7 days or Last 30 days in the Grafana time picker. Values reflect only recorded samples; offline intervals are not imputed. Hardware identity uses SensorDash metadata, not sensor ID patterns. Estimated accessory watts are not metered energy. GPU device families include GpuAmd, GpuNvidia and GpuIntel. Fan RPM statistics use role-bound radiator and pump sensors separately. Period-over-period comparisons use an equal duration and yield no value when either period is absent; rolling 24h peaks are not calendar-day aggregates. Sensor-stream presence is an observation indicator, not a percentage of PC uptime. Detailed temperature/power history and cooling accessory/fan timelines are provided on the dedicated Hardware Telemetry, Cooling and Electricity dashboards rather than duplicated here. Historical analysis refreshes every five minutes rather than polling a 30-day window every 15 seconds. The cooling summary shows four readable cards (radiator/pump tach peaks plus average coolant temperature and flow). Recording density and buffer health remain in the detailed coverage charts rather than duplicating cards. Optional quiet-period baselines use CPU Total and GPU Core utilization with a 15-minute qualification window, real-sample coverage and current-sample freshness; blank values are intentional when no samples qualify. Workload shares are percentages of observed CPU+GPU windows, not uptime. Classification uses the larger of the two 5-minute mean loads: low under 10%, moderate 10–59%, high 60%+. Idle baseline is separately qualified with 15 minutes of low activity.

Missing intervals are excluded; this is a sampled average rather than a time-weighted estimate. Sparkline shows a moving average over the selected time range, like the other Reporting Summary average cards; the large value is the average ending at the dashboard's current time.

options.content:
### REPORTING COVERAGE & RETRY BUFFER
Recording density and sensor-stream presence show observed samples, **not PC uptime**. Windows SQLite bytes are the local export retry spool, not the compressed long-term VictoriaMetrics history. For detailed live hardware, cooling and accessory electrical histories, open their dedicated dashboards.

panels.title: Recording density · observations per 5 minutes
panels.description: Shows gaps and reporting density, not a percentage of uptime. If the PC sleeps, lower counts are expected.

panels.title: Windows local telemetry buffer · disk footprint
panels.description: Current SQLite main database, WAL and SHM file bytes sampled through time. Not the size of individual sensors in VictoriaMetrics.

panels.title: Temperature sensors reporting within 1 hour
panels.description: Per-computer count of CPU temperature sensor streams with observations in the prior hour. GPU is a separate series, never an average.

options.content:
### COMPARE EQUAL-LENGTH PERIODS · OBSERVED SAMPLES
The **selected range** is compared with the immediately preceding range of equal duration (24 hours versus the previous 24 hours; 7 days versus the previous 7 days; 30 days versus the previous 30 days). Differences are current minus previous. A blank result means one period has insufficient observations. These are *observed sensor statistics*, not room-temperature-adjusted benchmarks.

panels.title: CPU peak temperature · change
panels.description: Difference between the current selected period and the preceding equally long period. Requires observations in both periods; no zero-filling. Values combine available sensors in the device family, not necessarily a single package probe.

panels.title: GPU peak temperature · change
panels.description: Difference between the current selected period and the preceding equally long period. Requires observations in both periods; no zero-filling. Values combine available sensors in the device family, not necessarily a single package probe.

options.content:
### DAILY TREND · ROLLING 24-HOUR PEAKS
Each point is the highest recorded CPU or GPU temperature during the preceding 24 hours, not an average and not a peak for a fixed calendar day. Gaps are preserved; incomplete windows can miss true peaks.

panels.title: Low workload · observed share
panels.description: CPU Total and GPU Core 5-minute average utilization are both below 10%. This is a load band, not thermally settled idle. Percentage of the observed 5-minute load windows with both CPU/GPU available and at least ten physical samples each. Gaps are excluded, not counted as idle. A valid observed window with zero qualifying windows in this band reports 0%, not missing; missing both-device coverage reports no value.
